caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair set against a plain, light beige background. The chair has a curved backrest composed of several thin vertical rods, all connected at both the rounded top rail and the seat. The seat of the chair is slightly contoured and has a medium brown wood finish, with shading to suggest dimension and glossy highlights. The chair's legs are turned and splayed outwards, with two at the front and two at the back, connected by horizontal stretchers for structural support. The overall color palette consists of different shades of brown and beige, with subtle variations in tone to indicate light and shadow on the wood surfaces. There are no additional objects or features in the image besides the chair itself.
title: Windsor Chair
